# 2a Subscriptions module, schema, subscriptions: contract

**Read first:** [build README → Phase 2](./README.md#phase-2-subscriptions) (and its Phase 1 section), [subscriptions module](../modules/subscriptions.md), [subscription management](../processes/subscriptions/subscription-management.md), [subscription fetch](../processes/subscriptions/subscription-fetch.md) (steps 3–6 and Headers: `output` implements them), [subscription format](../integrations/subscription-format.md), [data model → Subscriptions](../data-model.md#subscriptions), [ADR 0002](../adr/0002-modules-talk-through-ports-and-events.md), [ADR 0004](../adr/0004-one-shared-credential-per-endpoint.md), `internal/modules/servers/ports.go` and `servers/endpoint`, designs `RP-Subscriptions` and `RP-Subscription`, and the **As built** of 1a (module wiring, `store` style, `FieldErrors` with i18n keys), 1d (ports, `serverstest`) and 1g (pages, dialogs as pages).

**Done when:** the `subscriptions` module is enabled after `servers` and migrates the whole Phase 2 schema; subscriptions can be created, edited through the settings form, given servers (add from the active ones, remove, reorder by drag, by `J`/`K` and by ↑/↓), previewed (the exact headers and connection URIs, masked until **Reveal**, with hidden servers and why), and deleted while no link points to them (a deleted one counts until its tombstone ends); `output` builds every kind of response (ok, the four stubs, both formats, the headers) as pure functions; the module reacts to `server.activated` and `server.retired`, also with the real servers module; the servers pages show which subscriptions serve a server; every checklist line has its test.

No links in 2a: the `subs_links` table exists (written ahead), but links are created from 2b. Everything in 2a that counts links counts that table, so it works unchanged once 2b exists.

## Decisions

| Topic | Decision | Why |
|---|---|---|
| Module | Name `subscriptions`. `subscriptions.New(p Ports) *Module`. In 2a it implements `Module`, `Initializer`, `EventDeclarer`, `SettingsDeclarer`, `MessagesDeclarer`, `RouteDeclarer`, `NavDeclarer`, `SubscriberDeclarer`, `SubjectNamer`, `Searcher`. Later: `JobDeclarer`, `DashboardDeclarer`, `NotificationRenderer`, `SettingsPageDeclarer` (2c). `Init` builds the services (`Subs` now; `Links`, `Fetch`, `Alerts` later) with `Now: func() time.Time { return m.Now() }`. | Build README → Phase 2 layout. |
| Wiring | `cmd/proxier/main.go`: `srv := servers.New(); subs := subscriptions.New(subscriptions.Ports{Catalog: srv.EndpointCatalog()}); srv.SetUsage(subs.Usage()); return []module.Module{srv, subs}`. The ports read their module's services when called, so building them before `Init` is safe. | 1d: "other modules get them through main.go". |
| Imports | Non-test files of the module import from `internal/modules/servers` only the root package (port types) and `servers/endpoint`. `TestImportsOnlyServersPorts` parses every non-test `.go` file under the module (`go/parser`, `ImportsOnly`) and fails on any other `internal/modules/servers/…` import. | Build README rule "Ports only". |
| Flag | `servers.ServerEndpoints` gains `Flag string`: the country flag of the server's location (`country.Flag(s.Country)` in `catalog.build`). Pages show it; `output` doesn't need it. | The Add-servers list shows "flag, name, health". |
| Members | `subs_subscription_servers` rows hold the server id, its **name copied at add time**, a dense `position` (1…n) and `added_at`. A member the catalog no longer serves (retiring; a server that lost its endpoints) stays in the list, is shown "not in service" and is never served; `server.retired` removes it. | ADR 0002: no reads of `servers_` tables; names never change or get reused. |
| Names | Subscription name: trimmed, 1–60 characters, unique (exact match, `subs.err.name_taken`). Title: trimmed, 1–60; empty → the name. Description ≤ 1 000. Errors are `store.FieldErrors` (field → i18n key) and nothing is written. | subscription-management.md rules. |
| Formats | `output` registers `uri-plain` and `uri-base64`, in that order (`output.Names()`). A subscription allows at least one (`subs.err.no_format`), and its default is one of the allowed (`subs.err.default_not_allowed`: "Choose another default first"). Stored comma-joined in registry order. | Edge case "turn off the default". |
| Update interval | Whole hours, 1–168 (`subs.err.update_hours`). Default 12. | |
| Hide unhealthy | Off, or on with states ⊆ {`blocked`, `down`, `degraded`, `unknown`} (at least one when on; default `blocked,down`) and a grace of 0–10 080 minutes (default 30). A served server is **hidden** when its health is one of the states and `now − since ≥ grace`. `paused` is never hidden. If that hides every served server, none is hidden (`output` reports `AllHidden`). | modules/subscriptions.md; the design's four checkboxes. |
| Auto add | Turning it on sets `auto_add_since = now`; turning it off clears it. A `server.activated` whose event time is before `auto_add_since` is ignored. | "Only affects servers activated after it was turned on." |
| Add servers | `GET /subscriptions/:id/servers/add` lists the catalog's active servers that aren't members, by name, with flag and health; the admin ticks some. `POST` appends them at the end in that order. Each id is checked with `Catalog.Server` at save time; an id not served (failed, retiring, gone) refuses the whole save (`subs.ErrNotServed`, 409, nothing added). One `subscription.servers_changed{added}`. Without a catalog the button is hidden; with nothing to add it is disabled with the reason. | Edge case "add a failed server → not offered". |
| Remove | Strength 1 ("Remove de-1 from Family? Links stop showing it on their next fetch."). Positions are re-densified. `subscription.servers_changed{removed}`. | |
| Reorder | Three ways, one result. **Drag**: the platform's sortable list posts the whole order `order=<id>,<id>,…` to `/servers/order`; it must be a permutation of the current members, else `subs.ErrStaleOrder` (409) and the area re-renders as stored. **`J`/`K`** on the cursor row and the row's **↓**/**↑** buttons post `/servers/:server/move` with `dir=down\|up`; at an end nothing changes. A change records `subscription.servers_changed{reordered: true}`; no change records nothing. Answers re-render the Servers area (htmx) with `data-cursor` on the moved row; without htmx they redirect to the page. | ui/README "sortable list"; keys `J K` from the design. |
| Reactions | Subscriber `subscriptions.servers`, types `server.activated` and `server.retired`, actor `system`. **Activated**: for each subscription with `auto_add = 1` and `auto_add_since ≤ event time` that doesn't hold the server, look it up with `Catalog.Server` (not served any more → skip) and append it: one `servers_changed{added, auto: true}` per subscription. **Retired**: remove the server from every subscription that holds it: one `servers_changed{removed, reason: "retired"}` each (name from the stored copy). Both are idempotent: a second delivery finds nothing to do and records nothing. The handler reads the catalog through `DB.R` while the cursor transaction is open: fine in WAL mode, and the event it reacts to is committed. | subscription-management.md "reactions to servers"; ADR 0002. |
| Usage | `Module.Usage()` returns a `servers.UsageReader`: the names (sorted) of the subscriptions holding the server, and the number of **active, unexpired** links in them (`state = 'active' AND (expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at > now)`). servers' rotate dialog shows `servers.rotate.usage_none` when that is 0 links in 0 subscriptions (today it would say "0 links in 0 subscriptions"). | servers pages already ask it (1d, 1g). |
| `output` | One pure package, used by every preview (2a, 2b) and by the fetch (2b): `PickFormat`, `Select`, `URIs`, `StubText`, `StubURI`, `Headers`, `Escape`, `Build`. The response decision order is **deleted → disabled → expired → no servers in service → ok** (subscription-fetch.md step 4; "disabled wins" over expired). `Build` gets a localizer for the link's language and the display zone (stub texts and their dates). | One place decides what a link serves. |
| Stub entry | `vless://00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000@127.0.0.1:1?encryption=none&type=tcp&security=none#` + `Escape(text)`. `Escape` percent-encodes every byte except `A–Z a–z 0–9 - . _ ~` (spaces become `%20`), so the doc's example comes out exactly, including `%40` for `@`. The texts (link language): `links.stub.disabled` "⛔ Link disabled" / "⛔ Ссылка отключена", `links.stub.disabled.contact` "⛔ Link disabled · contact {contact}" / "⛔ Ссылка отключена · пишите {contact}", `links.stub.expired` "⏳ Expired on {date}" / "⏳ Срок истёк {date}", `links.stub.expired.contact` (+ " · contact {contact}" / " · пишите {contact}"), `links.stub.deleted` "⛔ Link removed" / "⛔ Ссылка удалена", `links.stub.empty` "⚠️ No servers yet" / "⚠️ Серверов пока нет". `{contact}` is `general.admin_contact`; empty → the variant without it. `{date}` is `loc.Date(expires − 1 s)`: the last day the link worked. | subscription-format.md. |
| Expiry instant | A link's expiry is stored as the **first moment it is expired** (a date-only expiry 2026-12-01 in Europe/Moscow is `2026-12-01T21:00:00Z`). Expired ⇔ `now ≥ expires`. `subscription-userinfo`'s `expire` is `unix(expires) − 1` (1796158799 for that example, the doc's value), `0` without one. | The doc's example; one comparison everywhere. |
| Headers | In this order, with these exact lower-case names (set through the header map, not `Set`, which would capitalise them): `profile-title: base64:<std base64 of the title>`, `profile-update-interval: <hours>`, `subscription-userinfo: upload=0; download=0; total=0; expire=<n>`, `content-disposition: inline; filename*=UTF-8''<Escape(title)>.txt`. The fetch handler adds `Content-Type: text/plain; charset=utf-8`; the public middleware adds `Cache-Control: no-store` and `X-Robots-Tag`. Tests read them from the header map (`rec.Header()["profile-title"]`). | subscription-fetch.md#headers. |
| URIs | `URIs` builds each served server's endpoints in endpoint order through `endpoint.URI` (the type's own URI, display name as the fragment), or `endpoint.MaskedURI` for a masked preview. New in servers: `endpoint.Type.Mask func(Endpoint) Endpoint` (vless-xhttp-tls: `Credential` and `Params["path"]` become `endpoint.Masked` = `••••••••`, the path keeping its leading `/`), `endpoint.URI(e)` (unknown type → error) and `endpoint.MaskedURI(e)` = the URI of the masked endpoint with the percent-encoded bullets turned back into `••••••••`, so it reads `vless://••••••••@nl-1.hosts…&path=%2F••••••••&…`. | One endpoint type knows its secrets; replacing a secret's text in a URI could hit other parts of it. |
| Display names | As stored on the endpoint ("🇳🇱 Netherlands 1"): the admin's location name, whatever the link's language. | Build README defaults. |
| Preview | `GET /subscriptions/:id/preview?format=<f>&reveal=1` (htmx fragment, also used inline on first render): `output.Build` for an **active link without expiry** of this subscription, stub texts in the admin's language. Shows the status line (`200 OK`), `content-type`, `cache-control` and `output`'s headers, then the lines; for a masked `uri-base64` the lines with "sent base64-encoded"; revealed (`reveal=1`, `Cache-Control: no-store`) the exact body. Below: hidden servers ("de-1 hidden: blocked for 2 h 32 min (more than 30 min)"), members not in service, and when `AllHidden` the line "Every server would be hidden, so all are served". A preview records nothing (no event, no fetch). | subscription-management.md step 4. |
| Delete | `GET /subscriptions/:id/delete` is a page styled as a dialog. Refused while any link points to the subscription that is **not deleted, or deleted but still inside its tombstone** (`deleted_at` + `subscriptions.tombstone` > now, read from the setting, not from whether the token was erased yet). The page lists the live links (2b adds **Move links to…** for them) and the tombstones with the day each ends ("Deleted links keep it until 7 Nov 2026"); the button is disabled. Otherwise strength 2: "Family and its order of 3 servers are deleted. No link uses it." → `POST` → `subscription.deleted{name}`; deleted links whose tombstone ended keep their row with `subscription_id = NULL` (the foreign key's `ON DELETE SET NULL`). `subs.ErrHasLinks` (409) when such a link appeared meanwhile. A tombstone therefore always has its subscription. | modules/subscriptions.md: "can't be deleted while links point to it"; the user's decision (build README). |
| Settings section | Registered in 2a with every key (the page arrives in 2c), in the leaf package `subscriptions/conf`: see below. | 2b reads `link_language`. |
| Events | Every Phase 2 type is declared now (table below), so later sub-phases only record. Each has `event.<type>`; the notifying ones have `notify.<type>` and `.body`. | 1a's pattern. |
| Pages | `/subscriptions` (list), `/subscriptions/new`, `/subscriptions/:id` (Servers, Settings, Preview, Links, Activity) — see **Pages**. | Designs `RP-Subscriptions`, `RP-Subscription`. |
| Nav, search, names | Nav: group `subscriptions`, **Subscriptions** `/subscriptions`, `g u`, order 10 (Links arrives in 2b). Search: subscriptions by name or title; label = name, meta "subscription · 3 servers", href = the page. `SubjectNamer`: `subscription` → name, `/subscriptions/<id>`. | ui/README global layout and keys. |
| Sortable (platform) | `proxier.js` gains a sortable list: a container `[data-sortable]` holding rows `[data-sort-id]`, each with a handle `[data-sort-handle]`, and a `form[data-sortable-form]` with `input[name=order]`. Pressing a handle makes its row `draggable`; `dragover` on another row moves the dragged row before or after it (by the pointer's half of the row); on `drop`/`dragend`, when the order changed, the ids in DOM order (comma-joined) go into `order` and the form is submitted with `requestSubmit()` (it is an htmx form, so the area swaps). Also: after any htmx swap, a `[data-cursor]` element becomes the cursor row (`setCursor` on its index). `J`/`K` need no script: the row's ↓/↑ buttons carry `data-key="J"`/`"K"` and `data-row-only`. | Routing lists reuse it in Phase 3. |
| Dates (platform) | `i18n.Localizer.Date(t)` renders the day in the localizer's zone: EN `1 Dec 2026`, RU `1 дек 2026`; `ShortDate(t)`: `1 Dec` / `1 дек`. Month abbreviations EN `Jan Feb Mar Apr May Jun Jul Aug Sep Oct Nov Dec`, RU `янв фев мар апр мая июн июл авг сен окт ноя дек`. | Stub texts and the pages. |
| Real-servers harness | `serverstest.WithModules(func(m *servers.Module) []module.Module) Option`: extra modules built from the servers module, registered after it. `NewHarness` must apply its options **before** it builds the site (today it builds the site first; `StubProxy` only sets a flag, so moving the loop up changes nothing else). `substest.WithServers(t)` builds it with `StubProxy()` and the subscriptions module wired like `main.go`. | Cross-module edge cases need the real dispatcher and real events. |

Settings section `subscriptions` (`subscriptions/conf`):

| Key | Kind | Default | Bounds, notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `subscriptions.link_language` | enum `en`, `ru` | `ru` | The language of new links' stub texts. |
| `subscriptions.expiry_warning` | duration | `72h0m0s` | 1 h – 720 h. `link.expiring_soon` this long before the expiry (2c). |
| `subscriptions.alert_networks` | int | `4` | 1–1 000. An alert when **more than** this many networks fetched a link in 24 h (2c). |
| `subscriptions.alert_apps` | int | `3` | 1–1 000. The same for apps (2c). |
| `subscriptions.network_country_url` | string | `https://ipinfo.io/{ip}/country` | Empty turns country lookups off; otherwise `http(s)://…` containing `{ip}`; ≤ 300 characters (2c). |
| `subscriptions.tombstone` | duration | `720h0m0s` | 24 h – 8 760 h. How long a deleted link serves "⛔ Link removed" before its URL answers `404` (2b), its token is erased (2c), and it stops holding its subscription (2a). The period in force applies to every deleted link. |
| `subscriptions.fetch_retention` | duration | `2160h0m0s` | 168 h – 8 760 h. Fetches older than this are deleted (2c). At least 7 days, because the link page counts the last 7 days. |

## Tables

`internal/modules/subscriptions/migrations/00001_subscriptions.sql`: every Phase 2 table. Times are `db.Time` text. Ids of other modules' things are plain integers (ADR 0002).

```sql
-- +goose Up

CREATE TABLE subs_subscriptions (
    id               INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    name             TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    title            TEXT NOT NULL,
    description      TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    formats          TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'uri-plain,uri-base64', -- allowed, comma-joined, in output.Names() order
    default_format   TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'uri-plain',
    update_hours     INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 12 CHECK (update_hours BETWEEN 1 AND 168),
    hide_unhealthy   INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (hide_unhealthy IN (0,1)),
    hide_states      TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'blocked,down',          -- of blocked, down, degraded, unknown
    hide_grace_min   INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 30 CHECK (hide_grace_min BETWEEN 0 AND 10080),
    auto_add         INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (auto_add IN (0,1)),
    auto_add_since   TEXT,                                          -- when auto_add was last turned on
    all_unhealthy_at TEXT,                                          -- the last subscription.all_unhealthy (at most hourly, 2b)
    created_at       TEXT NOT NULL,
    CHECK ((auto_add = 1) = (auto_add_since IS NOT NULL))
) STRICT;

-- The servers of a subscription, in order. server_id is the servers module's
-- id; the name is a copy (server names never change and are never reused), so
-- a page can name a member the catalog no longer serves.
CREATE TABLE subs_subscription_servers (
    subscription_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES subs_subscriptions(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    server_id       INTEGER NOT NULL,
    server_name     TEXT NOT NULL,
    position        INTEGER NOT NULL,                               -- 1..n, dense, rewritten on every change
    added_at        TEXT NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (subscription_id, server_id)
) STRICT;
CREATE INDEX subs_subscription_servers_server ON subs_subscription_servers(server_id);

CREATE TABLE subs_links (
    id                 INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    -- NULL only for a deleted link whose subscription was deleted after it
    subscription_id    INTEGER REFERENCES subs_subscriptions(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
    name               TEXT NOT NULL,
    note               TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    token              BLOB,                                        -- vault "link:<id>:token"; NULL once the tombstone ended
    token_lookup       BLOB UNIQUE,                                 -- vault.Lookup(token); NULL with the token
    state              TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('active','disabled','deleted')),
    expires_at         TEXT,                                        -- the first moment the link is expired; NULL = never
    language           TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (language IN ('en','ru')),
    format             TEXT,                                        -- override; NULL = the subscription's default
    alert_networks     INTEGER CHECK (alert_networks BETWEEN 1 AND 1000), -- override; NULL = the setting
    alert_apps         INTEGER CHECK (alert_apps BETWEEN 1 AND 1000),
    alerts_muted       INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (alerts_muted IN (0,1)),
    alerted_at         TEXT,                                        -- the last link.shared_suspected
    expiry_warned_at   TEXT,                                        -- link.expiring_soon sent for the current expiry
    expired_at         TEXT,                                        -- link.expired sent for the current expiry
    created_at         TEXT NOT NULL,
    disabled_at        TEXT,
    deleted_at         TEXT,
    last_fetch_at      TEXT,
    last_fetch_app     TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    last_fetch_network TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    CHECK (state = 'deleted' OR subscription_id IS NOT NULL),
    CHECK ((state = 'deleted') = (deleted_at IS NOT NULL)),
    CHECK ((token IS NULL) = (token_lookup IS NULL))
) STRICT;
-- Names are unique among links that aren't deleted.
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX subs_links_live_name ON subs_links(name) WHERE state <> 'deleted';
CREATE INDEX subs_links_subscription ON subs_links(subscription_id);

CREATE TABLE subs_fetches (
    id         INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    link_id    INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES subs_links(id),
    at         TEXT NOT NULL,
    ip         TEXT NOT NULL,
    network    TEXT NOT NULL,                                       -- IPv4 /24 or IPv6 /48: "198.51.100.0/24"
    user_agent TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',                            -- at most 256 characters
    app        TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',                            -- the app family; '' = unknown (counted by user_agent)
    format     TEXT NOT NULL,
    outcome    TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (outcome IN ('ok','stub-disabled','stub-expired','stub-deleted','stub-empty'))
) STRICT;
CREATE INDEX subs_fetches_link ON subs_fetches(link_id, at);
CREATE INDEX subs_fetches_at ON subs_fetches(at);

-- The country of each network seen in fetches, looked up by its first address
-- (2c). '' = unknown: the lookup is off or failed.
CREATE TABLE subs_network_countries (
    network      TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    country      TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    looked_up_at TEXT NOT NULL
) STRICT;

-- A cut-off: the link was disabled and its subscription's servers are rotated
-- one at a time (2d).
CREATE TABLE subs_cutoffs (
    id         INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    link_id    INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES subs_links(id),
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_by TEXT NOT NULL
) STRICT;
CREATE INDEX subs_cutoffs_link ON subs_cutoffs(link_id, id);

CREATE TABLE subs_cutoff_items (
    cutoff_id   INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES subs_cutoffs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    position    INTEGER NOT NULL,
    server_id   INTEGER NOT NULL,
    server_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    state       TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('waiting','running','done','failed','skipped')),
    job_id      INTEGER,                                            -- the rotation job, by value
    error       TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',                           -- failed: the rotation's error; skipped: why
    PRIMARY KEY (cutoff_id, position)
) STRICT;
CREATE INDEX subs_cutoff_items_job ON subs_cutoff_items(job_id);
-- One rotation at a time per cut-off.
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX subs_cutoff_items_running ON subs_cutoff_items(cutoff_id) WHERE state = 'running';

-- +goose Down
DROP TABLE subs_cutoff_items;
DROP TABLE subs_cutoffs;
DROP TABLE subs_network_countries;
DROP TABLE subs_fetches;
DROP TABLE subs_links;
DROP TABLE subs_subscription_servers;
DROP TABLE subs_subscriptions;
```

A new link is inserted with `token = X''` (an empty blob) and its lookup, then, in the same transaction, `token` is set to the seal made with the new id (2b). The `CHECK` holds throughout.

## Go signatures

### `subscriptions` (root)

```go
// Ports are what the module uses of other modules. A nil one hides its features.
type Ports struct {
	Catalog servers.EndpointCatalog
	Rotator servers.Rotator // 2d
}
type Module struct {
	Now  func() time.Time // the module's clock; tests replace it
	Subs *subs.Service
	// Links, Fetch, Alerts: 2b, 2c
}
func New(p Ports) *Module
func (m *Module) Usage() servers.UsageReader
```

### `subscriptions/output`

```go
const Masked = endpoint.Masked // "••••••••"

const (
	OK           = "ok"
	StubDisabled = "stub-disabled"
	StubExpired  = "stub-expired"
	StubDeleted  = "stub-deleted"
	StubEmpty    = "stub-empty"
)

var ErrBadFormat = errors.New("output: format not allowed")

type Format struct {
	Name   string
	Render func(lines []string) []byte // uri-plain: lines joined by "\n" plus a final "\n"; uri-base64: StdEncoding of that
}
func Lookup(name string) (Format, bool)
func Names() []string // "uri-plain", "uri-base64"
// PickFormat: the query's format when allowed; a non-empty query that is unknown
// or not allowed is ErrBadFormat; else the override when allowed; else def.
func PickFormat(query string, allowed []string, def, override string) (string, error)

type Server struct {
	ID          int64
	Name        string
	Health      string
	HealthSince time.Time
	Endpoints   []endpoint.Endpoint
}
type Hide struct {
	On     bool
	States []string
	Grace  time.Duration
}
type Hidden struct {
	Server Server
	For    time.Duration // how long it has been in its state
}
// Select keeps the order. allHidden: hiding would have left nothing, so served
// is every server and hidden is empty.
func Select(servers []Server, h Hide, now time.Time) (served []Server, hidden []Hidden, allHidden bool)
func URIs(servers []Server, masked bool) ([]string, error)

func Escape(s string) string
func StubURI(text string) string
// StubText is the stub's name in loc's language; outcome is one of the Stub*
// constants; expires matters only for StubExpired.
func StubText(loc *i18n.Localizer, outcome string, expires time.Time, contact string) string

type Header struct{ Name, Value string }
func Headers(title string, updateHours int, expires time.Time) []Header // expires zero: expire=0

type Link struct {
	State   string    // active, disabled, deleted
	Expires time.Time // zero: never
}
type Request struct {
	Link        Link
	Title       string   // the subscription's title
	UpdateHours int
	Format      string   // already picked
	Servers     []Server // the members the catalog serves now, in order
	Hide        Hide
	Contact     string
	Now         time.Time
	Masked      bool
}
type Response struct {
	Outcome   string
	Headers   []Header
	Lines     []string // the URIs, or the one stub entry
	Body      []byte   // Lines in Format
	Served    []Server
	Hidden    []Hidden
	AllHidden bool
}
func Build(loc *i18n.Localizer, r Request) (Response, error)
```

## Routes

| Method, path | What |
|---|---|
| `GET /subscriptions` | List |
| `GET /subscriptions/new`, `POST /subscriptions` | Create → `/subscriptions/:id` |
| `GET /subscriptions/:id` | The page |
| `POST /subscriptions/:id` | Save settings → the page with `?saved=1` ("Saved.") or `?saved=0` ("No changes."); errors inline, 422 |
| `GET /subscriptions/:id/servers/add`, `POST /subscriptions/:id/servers` | Add servers (`server=<id>` repeated) |
| `POST /subscriptions/:id/servers/:server/remove` | Remove (strength 1) |
| `POST /subscriptions/:id/servers/:server/move` | `dir=up\|down` |
| `POST /subscriptions/:id/servers/order` | `order=<id>,<id>,…` |
| `GET /subscriptions/:id/preview` | Preview fragment (`format`, `reveal=1`; `no-store` when revealed) |
| `GET /subscriptions/:id/delete`, `POST /subscriptions/:id/delete` | Delete → `/subscriptions` |

## Pages

- **Subscriptions** (`RP-Subscriptions`): the title block with the one-sentence explanation and **New subscription** (primary, key `n`). Rows (`data-row`, `data-href`): name with "shown in apps as “Семья”" under it; servers as status markers (healthy pine dot, blocked iris diamond, …; a member not in service: the `gone` dash) plus their names and "· de-1 hidden now"; live links; formats ("uri-plain (default), uri-base64"); hide unhealthy ("on · 30 min" / "off"). Empty state: what a subscription is, and **New subscription**.
- **New subscription**: a page styled as a dialog: name, title (placeholder: the name), description.
- **Subscription** (`RP-Subscription`): crumbs, the name, the status line "apps show “Семья” · 3 servers · 5 links", **Delete…** (small, danger) in the title block. Areas, in this DOM order (desktop: two columns, Servers and Settings left; phone: one column):
  1. **Servers · N**, title band button **Add servers…**, note "Drag, or J K on the selected row, to reorder. Links get the new order on their next fetch; there's nothing to push." A `[data-sortable]` list: handle ⋮⋮, position, flag + name (link to the server), health marker + word, output ("served" / "hidden since 14:50" in the state's colour / "not in service"), ↑ ↓ (small buttons, `data-key="K"`/`"J"`, `data-row-only`), **Remove**. Empty: "No servers yet. Its links serve “⚠️ No servers yet”." with **Add servers…**.
  2. **Settings**: a form with name, title (help "The subscription's name inside the apps."), description, formats (a checkbox per format and a "default" radio), "Update every [12] hours · a hint to the apps", hide unhealthy (a switch, the four state checkboxes, "for at least [30] min", the note "Never empties the output. If every server would be hidden, all are served and you get a notification."), new servers ("Add every server that becomes active"), **Save settings** and the saved note.
  3. **Preview** "exactly what a link gets now": a format select (allowed formats), **Reveal** / **Hide**, the fragment above, swapped by htmx.
  4. **Links · N**: the subscription's live links (2b fills it; until then "No links yet").
  5. **Activity**: the last 10 events of `subscription:<id>` (`events.List`), as the server page's recent events.

The phone layout comes from `app.css` (one column under 760 px, buttons full width); no separate template.

## Events

Declare every Phase 2 type now (`Module: "subscriptions"`). Recorded in 2a: `subscription.created`, `subscription.updated`, `subscription.deleted`, `subscription.servers_changed`.

| Type | Notify | Emoji | Subject | Payload |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `subscription.created` | off | | subscription | `name` |
| `subscription.updated` | off | | subscription | `changes`: the changed settings, comma-joined (`name, title, description, formats, default format, update interval, hide unhealthy, hidden states, grace, auto add`) |
| `subscription.deleted` | off | | subscription | `name` |
| `subscription.servers_changed` | off | | subscription | `added`, `removed` (names, comma-joined, `""` when none), `reordered` (bool); `auto: true` for the automatic add; `reason: "retired"` for a retirement |
| `subscription.all_unhealthy` | **on** | 🟡 | subscription | `servers` (names), `count` (2b) |
| `link.created` | off | | link | `subscription` (name), `expiry` (2b) |
| `link.disabled`, `link.enabled`, `link.token_regenerated`, `link.deleted` | off | | link | — (2b) |
| `link.subscription_changed` | off | | link | `from`, `to` (names) (2b) |
| `link.expiry_changed` | off | | link | `from`, `to` (2b) |
| `link.changed` | off | | link | `fields`: of `name, note, language, format, alert limits, alerts muted` (2b, 2c) — **new**, for the plain edits |
| `link.expiring_soon` | **on** | ⏳ | link | `expiry` (2c) |
| `link.expired` | **on** | ⏳ | link | `expiry` (2c) |
| `link.shared_suspected` | **on** | 🟡 | link | `networks`, `apps`, `window: "24h"` (2c) |
| `link.cut_off` | off | | link | `servers`, `skipped` (names) (2d) |

## Doc changes in the same commit

- `docs/modules/subscriptions.md`: hidden states are chosen from blocked, down, degraded, unknown (paused never hides); bounds (name and title 60, update interval 1–168 h, grace 0–10 080 min); a member the catalog no longer serves stays listed as "not in service" until retired; display names are the location's as entered, whatever the link's language; a deleted link holds its subscription until its tombstone ends; `LinkIssuer` arrives with Phase 4; the settings table of 2a (the tombstone period and fetch retention are settings now).
- `docs/processes/subscriptions/subscription-management.md`: **Add servers** appends the ticked servers in name order; reorder by drag, `J`/`K` or ↑/↓; **Remove** asks a simple confirmation; the preview shows hidden servers and members not in service, and records nothing; a subscription can be deleted only when no link points to it, a deleted link counting until its tombstone ends.
- `docs/processes/subscriptions/subscription-fetch.md` step 5.4: named with the endpoint's display name (drop "in the link's language").
- `docs/modules/servers.md`: drop "translations of location names will follow the link's language"; the catalog carries the location flag; `endpoint.MaskedURI`.
- `docs/processes/servers/server-provisioning.md` (Activate anyway): subscriptions that hide unhealthy servers hide it like any other, once it has been in a hidden state for their grace period.
- `docs/events.md#subscriptions`: the payloads of the table above and `link.changed`.
- `docs/data-model.md#subscriptions`: the columns as built (member name copy, `auto_add_since`, `all_unhealthy_at`, the link's warning marks), the cut-off and network tables.
- `docs/architecture.md#intended-code-layout`: the module's packages.
